member.name: T:DotNetCore.Collections.Paginable.KeysetPageAsyncExtensions
member.summary:
Async keyset (seek) pagination for EF Core, executed end-to-end as provider-native async database calls (ToListAsync(cancellationToken)).
Each request is a single WHERE key > @last ORDER BY key LIMIT @size query: no OFFSET scan, no COUNT(*) round trip - deep pages cost the same as shallow ones.

member.summary: Gets the first keyset page asynchronously (no keyset anchor applied).
member.typeparam: ordering key type; must support the > / < operators

example.code: var first = await query.GetFirstPageByKeysetAsync(x => x.Id, pageSize: 50, cancellationToken: cancellationToken); var lastId = first.LastMember.Id;
